```{r}
library(dplyr)
hotdog <- read.csv("~/Desktop/DS 4002/DS 4002_ Quick Survey For A Class Competition (Responses) - Form Responses 1.csv")

hotdog_clean <- rename(hotdog, response = IS.A.HOT.DOG.A.SANDWICH.
)

hotdog_clean <- hotdog_clean %>% 
  mutate(
    Major = str_to_upper(Major)             
  )

hotdog_clean

unique(hotdog_clean$Major)


```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)


ggplot(hotdog_clean, aes(x = response, fill = response)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Yes" = "orange", "No" = "blue")
  ) + 
  labs(
    title = "Is a Hot Dog a Sandwich?", 
    x = "Response", 
    y = "Number of Responses"
  )

```


```{r}

hotdog_clean<- hotdog_clean %>%
  count(Major, response) %>%
  group_by(Major) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100)

chisq.test(table(hotdog_clean$Major, hotdog_clean$response))

```
